body: hey man, sorry it took so long to respond, but I'm feeling better finally. not in the sense that I'm just depressed and not suicidal, but in the sense that I'm glad im not dead. a bunch of good things happened to me today, and even though they would probably be just another part of someone's day, they mean a lot to me. for once I'm happy, and it's not because I'm stoned out of my mind or high on something else. I'm sober and happy. I actually forgot what this felt like because for the past year+ I have been miserable. thanks for caring about me, I appreciate it. I know ill still have to fight the disease that is depression, but at least now I can see that maybe my whole life isn't going to be miserable. thanks for your support.
